newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to list Service Experts, Imax options.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to list Service Experts, Imax options.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange said Thursday it would list options on Imax Corp and Service Experts Inc on June 30.
The exchange said Imax options would open with strike prices of 20, 22-1/2, 25, with initial expirations in July, August, November and February. Spear, Leeds & Kellogg will be the specialist unit.
Service Experts options will have opening strikes of 22-1/2, 25 and 30 and expirations in July, August, November and February. TFM Investment Group will be the specialist.
Both options will have position limits of 4,500 contracts, the PHLX said.
By early Thursday afternoon, Imax shares traded in the U.S. were up 1-1/4 at 23-1/2 and Service Experts added 1/4 to 24-3/16.
